records.title: New knowledge source pipelines for sociocultural representations in a cognitive architecture
records.reason: The paper studies sociocultural representation effects in cognitive architectures using LLM and ConceptNet knowledge sources, not inference efficiency.

records.title: A Self-Adaptive Agentic Mixture-of-Agent Families with Agent-to-Agent Communication for Automatic Sentiment Analysis
records.reason: Sentiment-analysis accuracy and adaptive early exit are evaluated in an agentic mixture system, but the agents are statistical/deep-learning/attention models, not LLM serving; this is a task application.

records.title: Do Pre-Trained Code Models Add Value Beyond Software Metrics in Class-Level Defect Prediction? An Empirical Study of Input Coverage, Long-Code Aggregation, and Cross-Version Generalization
records.reason: This is a software defect-prediction quality study of code encoders, not LLM serving or inference efficiency.

records.title: Improving Performance–Efficiency Trade-offs Through Model Compression and Optimization Strategies
records.reason: The experiments compress ResNet/CNN image classifiers, not LLMs.

records.title: Hidden Language Consistency Phenomena in Reasoning LLMs
records.reason: The contribution measures multilingual reasoning-language consistency and quantization effects on capability, not inference cost or system efficiency.
